item.title: Introducing AI Answer Engine
item.description: New in American Banker, readers can search news and analysis to find what they need, powered by a hybrid AI search engine.

item.title: Ally beats estimates but predicts rise in unemployment
item.description: The auto lender's earnings mostly surpassed expectations in the fourth quarter, but its financial outlook was dampened by its projection of a weaker labor market in 2026.

item.title: LendingClub beats estimates; new accounting fuels stock dip
item.description: A one-time accounting change will boost the bank's ability to spend on marketing. Traders flinched at the change; analysts called it a buying opportunity.

item.title: Mastercard's CEO wades into affordability debate
item.description: The president has called for a 10% interest rate cap and endorsed the Credit Card Competition Act. Michael Miebach expressed strong opposition to the CCCA while expressing concern about a cap's potential impact on access to credit.

item.title: Mortgage rates rise as FOMC inaction adds to uncertainty
item.description: Even with the 4 basis point rise in the 30-year fixed over the past two weeks, mortgage rates are still hovering near three-year lows, Freddie Mac said.

item.title: Bread Financial mum on Trump's interest rate cap amid earnings beat
item.description: The credit card issuer said it had little to add to widespread discussions regarding the Trump administration's proposed 10% cap on credit card interest rates.

item.title: GAO chides OCC for not keeping Basel records 'confidential'
item.description: A Government Accountability Office report warns the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to clarify which records from the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision should be treated as federal records and thus retained according to the Federal Records Act.

item.title: Banks, credit unions are on the precipice of an open finance shift
item.description: American Banker research finds that most institutions are still planning out adoption, but see new data sharing products as crucial tools for growth.

item.title: Nubank receives conditional OCC approval for US charter
item.description: The Brazil-based fintech got conditional approval from the OCC to bring its digital banking services to U.S. customers.

item.title: Visa: Credit Card Competition Act not needed
item.description: CEO Ryan McInerney reiterated the company's long-held stance that the Credit Card Competition Act was "very harmful" and "just simply not needed."
